# TabbedContainer

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTabbedContainer` · **Group:** [Layout and structure](../Groups/Layout-and-structure.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTabbedContainer.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTabbedContainer.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTabbedContainer.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Tabs

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTabbedContainer> CreateTabbedContainerWithDropdown( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height, OverflowDropdownPosition dropdownPos = OverflowDropdownPosition::Left, bool enableSearch = true, int searchThreshold = 5);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasTabbedContainer> CreateTabbedContainer( const std::string& id, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasTabbedContainer(const std::string& elementId, float posX, float posY, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasTabbedContainer(const std::string& elementId, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasTabbedContainer(const std::string& elementId);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onNewTabRequest` | `std::function<void()> onNewTabRequest` | _New tab request_ |
| `onTabChange` | `std::function<void(int, int)> onTabChange` | (oldIndex, newIndex) |
| `onTabSelect` | `std::function<void(int)> onTabSelect` | (tabIndex) |
| `onTabClose` | `std::function<bool(int)> onTabClose` | (tabIndex) - return false to prevent |
| `onTabReorder` | `std::function<void(int, int)> onTabReorder` | (fromIndex, toIndex) |
| `onTabRename` | `std::function<void(int, const std::string&)> onTabRename` | (tabIndex, newTitle) |
| `onTabBarRightClick` | `std::function<void()> onTabBarRightClick` | _Tab bar right click_ |
| `onTabContextMenu` | `std::function<void(int, int, int)> onTabContextMenu` | (tabIndex, windowX, windowY) on right-click |
| `onTabHover` | `std::function<void(int)> onTabHover` | (tabIndex, or -1 when no tab is hovered) |
| `onTabDragOut` | `std::function<bool(int tabIndex, int screenX, int screenY)> onTabDragOut` | / Tab dragged out of the tab bar beyond threshold. / @param tabIndex Index of the dragged tab / @param screenX Screen X coordinate of mouse at drag-out / @param screenY Screen Y coordinate of mouse at drag-out / @return true if the handler removed the tab (e.g., moved to new window) |
| `onTabDragIn` | `std::function<int(const TabTransferData& data, int insertionIndex)> onTabDragIn` | / External tab offered for insertion via AcceptTabTransfer(). / @param data Transfer data for the incoming tab / @param insertionIndex Suggested insertion position / @return New tab index if accepted, -1 to reject |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md): `SetScrollChangedCallback`, `SetChildAddedCallback`, `SetChildRemovedCallback`
- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `TabPosition`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Top` |  |
| `Bottom` |  |
| `Left` |  |
| `Right` |  |

### enum `TabStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Classic` | Traditional rectangular tabs |
| `Modern` | Flat with subtle borders |
| `Flat` | Minimal style, no borders |
| `Rounded` | Browser-style rounded tops |
| `Pill` | Capsules floating in the bar: the open tab outlined, the others plain |
| `Custom` | User-defined rendering |

### enum `TabCloseMode`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoClose` | No close buttons |
| `Closable` | Close buttons on all tabs |
| `ClosableExceptFirst` | Close buttons on all except first tab |

### enum `OverflowDropdownPosition`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Off` | No dropdown shown |
| `Left` | Dropdown at left side of tabs |
| `Right` | Dropdown at right side of tabs |

### enum `NewTabButtonPosition`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AfterTabs` | Right after the last tab |
| `FarRight` | At the far right of the tab bar |
| `BeforeTabs` | Left of the first tab |

### enum `NewTabButtonShape`

The "+" is not a full-height block of the tab bar: it is a small shape centred in its slot, so its hover highlight sits clear of the tab outlines next to it.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `RoundedSquare` | Square with rounded corners (newTabButtonCornerRadius) |
| `Circle` | Round highlight |
